# Black Rabbit Landscaping

> Owner-operated lawn care, landscaping and seasonal property services based in Rainier, WA 98576, serving Washington's South Sound. 8 years in business: Jerry started it in Florida and is now based in Rainier, WA (that's why the phone is a 407 number). Licensed WA contractor BLACKRL740MU, bonded and insured.

Contact: call or text (407) 951-1663 · blackrabbitlandscaping@gmail.com · https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/
Owner: Jerry
Areas served: Olympia, Lacey, Tumwater, Yelm, Rainier and Tenino (Thurston County) and Roy (Pierce County).
Pricing: free quote for every job, except sprinkler winterizing ($85-125 per house plus about $9 per extra zone).

## Services
- [Lawn mowing](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/lawn-mowing)
- [Cut My Grass online booking](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/cut-my-grass)

- [Storm cleanup](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/storm-cleanup)
- [Hedge and shrub trimming](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/hedge-trimming)
- [Gutter cleaning and roof moss removal](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/gutter-cleaning-roof-moss): roof moss is removed by hand only. Gutter and moss work is done with a trusted partner while ladder insurance is pending.
- [Pressure washing](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/pressure-washing)
- [Holiday light installation and takedown](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/holiday-lights)
- [Sprinkler winterizing](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/sprinkler-winterizing): $85-125 per house plus about $9 per extra zone; book before the first hard freeze, around Nov 1.
- [Blackberry clearing](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/blackberry-clearing)
- [Commercial and HOA property maintenance](https://www.blackrabbitlawn.com/commercial-hoa-property-maintenance)
